fields.name: Death Benefit

fields.condition: If a motor vehicle is 25 years or more of age which is not used for any commercial or business purposes
fields.outcome: Then it qualifies as an Antique Motor Vehicle and is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If a motor vehicle is of unique or rare design and of limited product that is an object of curiosity and which is not used for any commercial or business purposes
fields.outcome: Then it qualifies as a Classic Motor Vehicle and is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If a motor vehicle, typically manufactured within the past 14 years, which because of its specific make, model year of manufacture, and exceptional physical condition, is considered to be increasing in value rather than depreciating in value
fields.outcome: Then it qualifies as an Exotic or Special Interest Motor Vehicle and is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If an enthusiast vehicle has been retrofitted with an electric drivetrain
fields.outcome: Then it qualifies as an Electric Vehicle Conversion and is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If a vehicle has been modified to a significant extent and is highly customized for looks and/or performance (e.g., customized engine, body kit, or large-bodied vehicle with custom rims of 22" or more or 100-spoke type rims)
fields.outcome: Then it qualifies as a Highly Modified Vehicle / a Low-Rider and is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If a vehicle was originally manufactured prior to 1950 and has been modified to increase performance
fields.outcome: Then it qualifies as a Hot Rod/Street Rod and is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If an original-bodied vehicle has had multiple significant mechanical, non-cosmetic components replaced with modern equivalents to increase safety and performance to levels similar to a newer vehicle
fields.outcome: Then it qualifies as a Restomod / a Tuner and is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If the vehicle is a non-motorized vehicle designed to be towed, and featuring living accommodations which may include cooking, heating/cooling, bathroom plumbing, and sleeping arrangements, and may include fifth-wheel trailers, but do not include self-propelled vehicles, truck-mounted camper bodies, semi-trailers, or trailers used for any commercial purpose or as a vehicle conveyance
fields.outcome: Then the vehicle qualifies as a Camper Trailer and it is eligible for the Core Product

fields.condition: If the vehicle is a 2- or 3-wheeled vehicle of the motorbike, motorcycle, moped, or motor scooter type designed for travel on public roads, and any sidecar designed for use with the same collector vehicle
fields.outcome: Then the vehicle qualifies as a Collector Motorcycle and it is eligible for the Core Product

fields.condition: If the vehicle is specifically purpose-built for competition type use rather than street use, including competition cars with historic significance or provenance
fields.outcome: Then the vehicle qualifies as Motorsports and it is eligible for the Core product

fields.condition: If the vehicle has been modified after manufacture for drag racing rather than street use, including at minimum, a roll cage, narrowed rear axle, and enlarged rear wheel wells/wheels
fields.outcome: Then the vehicle qualifies as Pro-street and it is eligible for the Core Product

fields.condition: If the insured has another means of daily transportation which is not insured in the Classic Automobile Program
fields.outcome: Then the vehicle is eligible for Core

fields.condition: If the vehicle is primarily used for auto club activities, exhibits, parades, or a private collection (not including racing, rallies, or any other type of speed or timed event)
fields.outcome: Then the vehicle is eligible for Core

fields.condition: If the vehicle is occasionally used for purposes other than auto club activities, exhibits, parades, or a private collection, so long as the insured maintains and insures a means of daily transportation
fields.outcome: Then the vehicle is eligible for Core

fields.condition: If the Product is Core and the Line of Business is Personal Auto
fields.outcome: Then the policy will be written for a period of 1 year

fields.condition: If an individual who is a visitor from outside the U.S. is traveling in the U.S.
fields.outcome: Then Liability and/or Physical Damage Coverage may be purchased for their collector vehicle as temporary coverage not to exceed 90 days, subject to the minimum premium shown in the Rule Reference

fields.condition: If an individual is a U.S. resident with an unregistered vehicle
fields.outcome: Then Physical Damage Coverage may be purchased as temporary coverage not to exceed 90 days, subject to the minimum premium shown in the Rule Reference

fields.condition: If the Product is Core
fields.outcome: Then the minimum annual written premium charge for all coverage combined shall be the amount shown in the Rule Reference

fields.condition: If the Product is Core
fields.outcome: Then the minimum premium per coverage shall be the amount shown in the Rule Reference

fields.condition: If the vehicle type is applicable as shown in the Vehicle Type Applicability Reference; and there is Liability, Collision, and/or Other Than Collision coverage selected
fields.outcome: Then the Auto Theft Prevention Authority Fee will be applied on an annual basis to all motor vehicles on the policy in the amount shown in the Rule Reference

fields.condition: If the vehicle type is applicable as shown in the Vehicle Type Applicability Reference; and Liability Coverage is selected
fields.outcome: Then the Automobile Theft Authority Fund Fee will be applied on an annual basis to each vehicle with Liability Coverage in the amount shown in the Rule Reference

fields.condition: If the vehicle is installed with a homing device or system that transmits a signal by which the vehicle location may be tracked, is activated when the vehicle is stolen or reported stolen to police, transmits to local and/or state police or a private central monitoring station in communication with police, and provides vehicle location information to the proper authorities for recovery
fields.outcome: Then the Homing Device Credit applies

fields.condition: If the policyholder is a member of Hagerty Drivers Club
fields.outcome: Then the Mass Marketing Discount applies

fields.condition: If the selected Pay Plan is Full Pay
fields.outcome: Then the Paid-In-Full Discount applies

fields.condition: If, the applicant was continuously insured for at least 1 year with a specialty collector vehicle carrier immediately prior to applying for coverage with us
fields.outcome: Then the Prior Specialty Carrier Discount applies

fields.condition: If a policy originally written under a non-Essentia insurance program is converted to the Core Program as part of a qualifying portfolio transfer
fields.outcome: Then the Portfolio Transfer Discount is applied for the first 2 policy terms

fields.condition: If the state-wise criteria for the Accident Prevention Course Discount are met as shown in the rule reference
